text.p: Bulgarian playmaker Krasimir Balakov on Friday extended his contract with VfB Stuttgart, committing himself to the Bundesliga side until the year 2000.

The dazzling midfielder's partnership with strikers Fredi Bobic and Giovane Elber has been dubbed the "magic triangle" by the German press. His current contract was due to expire at the end of this season.
"The contract doesn't have any opt-out clauses," club president Gerhard Mayer-Vorfelder said. "We aim to keep this team together and Balakov is at the heart of the side."
Stuttgart, leading the Bundesliga after 12 games, face St Pauli on Saturday. Second-placed Bayern Munich could go top, at least for a day, if they beat 1860 Munich on Friday.
